description: Recording-balanced dynamic-crop ablation after F0/F1b validation diagnostics.

comparison.reference: F0-S0 frozen encoder with fixed anchors
comparison.candidate: F0-S1 frozen encoder with class-then-recording-balanced dynamic crops

sampling.crop_seed: deterministic from model seed, epoch, class, and draw

selection.required_secondary_condition: validation recording macro-F1 does not regress

decision_after_seed42.candidate_passes: retain S1, then evaluate last-2 on S1
decision_after_seed42.candidate_fails_without_residual_vessel_: stop sampling branch and run context/pretraining controls
decision_after_seed42.residual_vessel_bias_or_clear_s1_gain: S2 sampler is implemented; run it only after reviewing S1 validation
decision_after_seed42.never_from_this_result: run last-8 or tune against DeepShip test
